end_earliest.BELOW_ZONE_RESET: close of the second consecutive completed session with coordinate High < L
end_earliest.HARD_STRUCTURAL_RESET: new causally known lower MAJOR/SECONDARY true gap at formation close or lower causal cluster at its freeze
end_earliest.SUCCESS: current attack reaches U on same-lineage hard-valid price path
end_earliest.TIME_RESET: close of calendar index ATTACK_START_CAL_IDX + 10 without earlier U/reset

freshness: attack start gap age <= 90 completed sessions
later_attack: strictly after ended attack and a new causal upward contact from below
later_success_credit: never credited to an earlier failed/timed-out attack

outcomes.CLEAN_ATTACK_SUCCESS_10: U within 10 sessions before 8% adverse mark
outcomes.CLEAN_ATTACK_SUCCESS_5: U within 5 sessions before 5% adverse mark
outcomes.EVENTUAL_U_AFTER_FAILED_ATTACK: U in a later attack/history; diagnostic only
outcomes.FAILED_ATTACK: hard structural or below-zone reset before U
outcomes.ROUGH_ATTACK_SUCCESS: U before reset but not CLEAN_ATTACK_SUCCESS_10

start: previous completed minute coordinate close < L and current completed minute coordinate high >= L; ATTACK_1 is the frozen V6 causal first return
